# Read all habit tracking notes (726-741) to extract habit names and daily values
notes_data = []
for note_id in range(726, 742):
    note = apis.simple_note.show_note(note_id=note_id, access_token=access_token)
    # Parse content: lines after the header line "# Daily Habit Tracker..."
    lines = note['content'].split('\n')
    # Find the line that starts with "exercised" or first habit line
    habit_lines = [line for line in lines if ':' in line and not line.startswith('#')]
    # Each line like "habit: yes/no"
    habits = {}
    for line in habit_lines:
        habit, value = line.split(':', 1)
        habits[habit.strip()] = value.strip()
    # Extract date from title: "Habit Tracking Log for YYYY-MM-DD"
    date_str = note['title'].split('for ')[1].strip()
    notes_data.append({'date': date_str, 'habits': habits})
    print(f"Read note {note_id}: {date_str}")
